status: PROPOSED ONLY; no numeric fields read; requires integrating-lead review
five_specific_reuse: ERBB2/TACSTD2/NECTIN4/FOLR1 R8 FDA6 source-condition contrasts and original CD276 LGFMS contrast remain as scientifically evaluated; no rerun.
proposal_question: Do the existing validated native EMC summaries identify an abundance, reproducibility or malignant-comparator pattern for GPNMB or LRRC15 that would change the priority or compartment design of a clinically grounded tissue localization experiment, even if the older stringent surface-gene allocation rule was not met?
purpose: Resolve exactly why each administrative allocation was False before choosing whether a scientifically meaningful distinct RNA association is present. This is all-field prior-result reuse, not a new target screen or a claim that a failed flag is a discovery.
unit: Nine original primary non-known-overlap EMC source specimens, not proven independent donors; same-source MLPS14/LGFMS13/synovial18 and recorded year-matched analyses. Preserve all original cohort exclusions and effect definitions.
clinical_consequence: A robust, cross-comparator native signal could justify tumor-cell-versus-stroma co-localization in molecularly authenticated EMC; shared myxoid/stromal signal or severe heterogeneity would instead change sampling/control requirements. It cannot establish accessible protein or therapy benefit.
strongest_alternative: Shared stromal or mesenchymal expression and differing bulk-tissue admixture; antigen-compartment interpretation cannot be assigned from RNA. Normal/array/3SEQ and all identifiable other EMC conditions remain required before any new biological promotion.
no_new_cutoffs: Use unchanged old summaries and allocation definition to understand the earlier decision; no new threshold, gene, case subgroup, ranking, multiplicity adjustment or statistic. Any useful new quantitative claim needs a separate exact question and root-approved method before further outcomes.
defeat: Existing summaries show only the already rejected generic specificity/ubiquity question, or cannot motivate a consequential compartment experiment beyond published clinical target rationale. A successful allocation flag is not required or sufficient for scientific value.
limits: Known earlier whole-gene exposure means exploratory; no blinded or preregistered-discovery claim. Prior published diagnostic/clinical and native EMC literature must still be assessed; suitable pending data blocks promotion.
